tasks.spec: Create a candidate-only Fleet Wave controller integration without mutating the dirty canonical checkout. Work only inside this task directory except for read-only Git access to /Users/hermes/ringer. First record the canonical checkout's symbolic branch, HEAD, and SHA-256 of `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall`. Clone /Users/hermes/ringer into ./repo. Create branch candidate/fleet-wave-controller-20260716-v1 from the exact recorded canonical HEAD. From reviewed source commit 3869357ed28859be9cbcd095f216edaa2b3bfcfc, copy exactly these six paths byte-for-byte into the candidate: docs/fleet-wave-protocol.md, schema/fleet-wave-receipt.v1.json, schema/fleet-wave.v1.json, templates/fleet-wave/manifest-v1.json, tests/test_fleet_wave.py, tools/fleet_wave.py. Do not change any other path. Commit exactly once over the base using a local repository-only Git identity. Run `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_fleet_wave` and `git diff --check BASE..CANDIDATE`; both must pass. Create candidate.bundle containing refs/heads/candidate/fleet-wave-controller-20260716-v1, integration.patch as the exact `git diff --binary BASE..CANDIDATE`, and changed-files.txt as the sorted exact six-path list. Copy /Users/hermes/.hermes/worktrees/ringer-fleet-wave-candidate-20260716-v1/checks/fleet_wave_candidate_bundle.py to candidate_check.py without editing it. Write candidate.json with schema_version fleet-wave-candidate.v1; source_controller_sha; base_branch/base_sha; candidate_branch/candidate_sha; booleans canonical_checkout_mutated=false, merged=false, deployed=false; the exact source_files SHA-256 map encoded by candidate_check.py; successful test command/exit_code records; patch_sha256; and canonical_checkout containing path, branch_before/after, head_before/after, status_sha256_before/after. Re-read the canonical checkout at the end and fail if branch, HEAD, or status digest changed. Write integration-report.md containing the exact source/base/candidate SHAs and the phrases `candidate only`, `not merged`, and `not deployed`, plus verification and rollback instructions. Run candidate_check.py yourself. Remove ./repo before exiting so only the bounded evidence artifacts remain. Never push, merge, deploy, restart, change services, modify Beads/Paperclip, print credentials, or write outside this task directory.
tasks.check: set -eu; expected='41e2d5cf26f570d9417452f136a847bb59848a87c0bf1489568cd423eedd9220'; actual=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 candidate_check.py | /usr/bin/cut -d ' ' -f 1); if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then echo "FAIL candidate_check.py hash $actual does not match versioned oracle $expected" >&2; exit 1; fi; /usr/bin/python3 candidate_check.py --candidate candidate.json --bundle candidate.bundle --patch integration.patch --report integration-report.md --changed changed-files.txt
tasks.verified: The executed oracle proves a one-commit, exact-six-file Fleet Wave candidate based on the bound Aegis HEAD, with byte-identical reviewed controller files, valid Git bundle/patch evidence, an unchanged canonical checkout, and a fresh 37/37 controller test replay.
